entities.name: Green
entities.description: One of the five colors of mana, drawn from forests and embodying instinct, interdependence and growth through acceptance.

entities.name: Red
entities.description: A color of mana allied with green, valuing instinct but disliked by green for its chaotic, destructive nature.

entities.name: White
entities.description: A color of mana allied with green, sharing a concern for community but emphasizing civilization and laws.

entities.name: Blue
entities.description: An enemy color of green, seen as obsessed with technology and deception.

entities.name: Black
entities.description: An enemy color of green, hated for its parasitic nature and use of the undead.

entities.name: Council of Colors
entities.description: The body whose current green member is Adam Prosak.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungal creatures that produce saprolings which nourish them, cited as an example of the circle of life.

relations.note: Allied colors on the color pie.
relations.quote: On the color pie , it is the ally of red and white , and the enemy of black and blue .
